content: Mago vekamoꞌmo aꞌmo aliꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo neꞌyaꞌmo neꞌnaya gemae
Lole afinaꞌmo utegeno mago vekamoꞌmo aꞌmo aliꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo Kena taonimo Galeliya kotegamo neꞌyaꞌmo neꞌnae. Yesu itaꞌamoꞌmo ani nopiꞌmo haino maiꞌniye.
Ani vayaꞌmogimo Yesuꞌe geꞌamo neꞌafiya vayaꞌefeꞌmo ge huꞌnageꞌa eꞌa maiꞌnae.
Mani asole vayaꞌmo maiꞌnayaꞌmofeꞌmo nofi alagafati aniꞌmo ago neꞌa hano huꞌnagenoꞌaeꞌmo Yesu itaꞌamoꞌmo agaefeꞌmo, nofi alagafati aniꞌapimo ago neꞌa hano huꞌnae, huno ha paiꞌnigenoꞌaeꞌmo,
ane, Nagaemo hisuva kavaꞌmo kagae aliꞌyaꞌmo ohaneꞌnifa nagaiꞌni aliꞌyaꞌnimo haneꞌniye. Nagae afinaꞌmo afole oꞌaiꞌniye, huno ha paiꞌniye.
Yesu itaꞌamoꞌmo aliꞌyaꞌmo neꞌaliya vayaꞌaifeꞌmo, na agufa kavaꞌmo hiyo, huno lapa paisifi geꞌamo akame hutapa hiyo, huno hapa paiꞌniye.

Ani nopiꞌmo sigisiꞌa yafa ani keꞌmo haneꞌnigeno Yu vayaꞌai mono kavaꞌapimo akame huꞌa aniꞌmo nefalaya keꞌmo haneꞌniye. Ani kepiꞌmo teniꞌa paketi aniꞌmo haneꞌnisifi fifitiniꞌa paketi aniꞌmo haneꞌnisifi huno haneꞌniya agufa keꞌmo haneꞌniye.
Yesuꞌa aliꞌyaꞌmo neꞌaliya vayaꞌaifeꞌmo, utapa aniꞌmo hefilitetapa muki keꞌafiꞌmo lakitapa havai teyo, huno hapa paiꞌnigeꞌa uꞌa hefili eꞌa lakiꞌa havai teꞌnagenoꞌaeꞌmo,
ani ani kepatiꞌmo hefilitutapa neꞌyateꞌmo neꞌyagaiya vekamo amiyo, huno hapa paiꞌniye. Anilafaꞌmo hefiliꞌa uꞌa amiꞌnageno neno afi geꞌniye.

Agaemo nofi alagafati aniꞌmo alino hamaleno ateꞌniya anikeꞌmo neꞌniye. Haiyaꞌalegatiꞌmo ani nofi alagafati aniꞌmo aliniꞌa eꞌnafi huno oꞌageꞌniyaꞌmonanafa aliꞌyaꞌmo neꞌaliya vayaꞌmogi ani aniꞌmo he fiꞌapaekeꞌmo ageꞌnae. Netenoꞌaeꞌmo aꞌmo aliꞌniya vekaeꞌmo gemo huꞌnigeno eꞌnigeno ha painoꞌaeꞌmo,

muki vayaꞌmogimo hogoteꞌa neꞌyaꞌmo neꞌnaya yateꞌmo eꞌa maiꞌnaya vayaꞌmo alagepa nofi alagafati anikeꞌmo aliꞌa lakiꞌa apamiꞌnageꞌa asole aniꞌmo netageꞌapaekeꞌmo henagaꞌageꞌmo hosuꞌniya nofi alagafati aniꞌmo aliꞌa neꞌapamiye. Ani kavaꞌmo nehayaꞌmonanafa kagaemo hemenimo alagepa nofi alagafati aniꞌmo maleka maiꞌneka alinikeka nelamine, huno ha paiꞌniye.

Yesuꞌa hogote afinaꞌmo mani noꞌagaya aune kavaꞌmo Kena taonifiꞌmo huꞌniye. Ani taonifiꞌmo ha le konali yaꞌamo alino apave liꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo geꞌamo neꞌafiya vayaꞌmogimo agaefeꞌmo apakesa afiꞌa fatago huꞌnae.
Henagaꞌamo Yesuꞌagi itaꞌamoꞌagi aganaꞌamogimogi geꞌamo neꞌafiya vayaꞌamogi huꞌa Kapeneyamu taonifiꞌmo uꞌa aise afinaꞌmo maiꞌnae.
Yesuꞌa Yu vayaꞌai alopa mono nopiꞌmo uno haiꞌniya gemae
Yu vayaꞌai hopa afinaꞌmo Pasova neꞌyaꞌmo neꞌnaya afinaꞌmo eno hogo huꞌnigenoꞌaeꞌmo Yesuꞌa Yulusalemu taonifiꞌmo uꞌniye.

Uno Yu vayaꞌai alopa mono nopiꞌmo haino apakeyana ani vayaꞌmogimo pulumakagi sipisipigi namagi huꞌa maketi nehaya vayaꞌmo maige alu nofi vayaꞌai monimo aliteꞌa Yu nofi vayaꞌai monimo aliteꞌa neꞌapamiya vayaꞌmo maige huꞌa maiꞌnageno apakeꞌniye.

Agaemo nofiꞌmo alino ana aeno nofi kayoꞌmo alo huno aliꞌneno sipisipiꞌe pulumakaꞌeꞌmo alino hapafaitalegeꞌa apaune hetaleꞌa kumatega lamiꞌnae. Agaemo alu nofi vayaꞌai monimo aliteꞌa Yu nofi vayaꞌai monimo aliteꞌa neꞌapamiya vayaꞌai hiꞌyalamuꞌapimo alino agoꞌya faino ataleteno alaga moniꞌapimo alino aino atagu faeno ataleꞌniye.
Agaemo namamo miya nefaiya vayaꞌaifeꞌmo, afoꞌnimo nopiꞌmo situvamo malegekana agufa kavaꞌmo nehagi mani namamo alinitapa viyo, huno hapa paiꞌniye.

Ani afinaꞌmo geꞌamo neꞌafiya vayaꞌmogi Goti mukufiꞌmo avoꞌmo kae maleꞌniya geꞌaeꞌmo apakesa afiꞌa ho huꞌnae. Ani gemoꞌmo, kagae noꞌmo alagepa huno hanesiyafeꞌmo naya mukiki nehuva kavaꞌmo atagana huno leno nasaga liꞌniye, huno huꞌniye.
Ani kavaꞌmo huꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo Yu vayaꞌmogi ageteꞌa, kagaemo mani kavaꞌmo nehanaꞌmofeꞌmo na alagena yaꞌmo neꞌyagaina yaꞌmo aliꞌnapigi alika lave ligane, huꞌa afi geꞌnae.
Afi geꞌnagenoꞌaeꞌmo, mani Goti mono noꞌamo hetapa halagape vaisageꞌnaeꞌmo loleꞌe magoꞌe afinaꞌmo halate aliꞌna kiꞌna hano huguve, huno hapa paiꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo,
asole vayaꞌmogimo, foti sigisiꞌa kafugafiꞌmo kime kime eꞌa kiꞌa hano huꞌnayaꞌmonanafa kagaemo loleꞌe magoꞌe afinaꞌmo halate alika kika hano hugapiye, huꞌa afi geꞌnayaꞌmonanafa
Yesuꞌa agaiꞌa agufaeꞌmo huꞌniye.

Gotiꞌa faliꞌniyatetiꞌmo halate alino he tino ateꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo geꞌamo neꞌafiya vayaꞌmogi ani huꞌniya geꞌaeꞌmo apakesa afiꞌa ho huteꞌa Goti Mukufiꞌmo avoꞌmo kae maleꞌniya geꞌenagi Yesuꞌa huꞌniya geꞌenagi huꞌa apakesa afiꞌa fatago huꞌnae.
Yesuꞌa muki vayaꞌai apaipafiꞌmo apakeꞌniya gemae
Pasova neꞌyaꞌmo neꞌnaya afinaꞌmo Yesuꞌa Yulusalemu taonifiꞌmo maiꞌnenoꞌaeꞌmo noꞌagaya aune kavaꞌmo huꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo asole vayaꞌmogimo ageteꞌa agaefeꞌmo apakesa afiꞌa fatago huꞌnae.
Huꞌnayaꞌmonanafa Yesuꞌa muki ma mopafi vayaꞌai apaipafiꞌmo ago apakeꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmo alagi lama ge nehae, huno agesa oꞌafiꞌnifa afaꞌa yagu yaga huno maiꞌniye.
Gemo afino alagepa huno afiteno apakesiyafeꞌmo mago vayaꞌmogi apava gemo huꞌa ha opaigafa agaiꞌageꞌmo muki ma mopafi vayaꞌai apaipafiꞌmo ago apakeꞌniye.
